outcome: severity of behaviours that challenge (Child Behaviour Checklist scores)
cohort: 261 dyads (parent and child) where children were aged 30-59 months with moderate to severe intellectual disabilities.
finding: The Stepping Stones Triple P intervention did not significantly reduce behaviours that challenge compared to treatment as usual overall, but an effect was observed for participants who received a sufficient dose of the intervention, and it was considered cost-effective.
